Latest current-base candidate 84a8d48cd568a99b0cc76e3f80a297f7f9ed69bf contains main83c5999bb6658c9009c81bc70cb444b8a8e0a9c4 through normal merges. Every scoped feature file is byte-identical to the immediately preceding validated candidate (17 files); no additional implementation changes. Independent parity review is clear. Fresh service RoleOneRolesTest +HandCostTest on latest main passes21 tests /379 assertions; other local gates below remain valid carried evidence for unchanged source. Exact-head full CI is starting; earlier CI statuses/heads below are historical. Draft only; no merge.

Current-base refresh (26 November 2026): normal merge of main3b6ade1fea10bcb73fa367aec6809c70a2862789; new candidate 2ba4b4ff9ea1493c4aa32fb860a1a98f6c115e21. All 17 original slice files remain byte-identical. Independent parity review is clear; no new business logic, existing assertion, migration or permission change.

Fresh local checks passed: 43 focused Feature tests /970 assertions,10 frontend tests, scoped Pint and PHPStan zero errors. Earlier full validation and visual evidence remain carried evidence for the unchanged slice; exact-head full CI is pending. Original stale-base attestation failure is addressed by current-main ancestry. This remains a draft with no merge authorization.

Historical evidence below is superseded only for base/head/CI status by this update.

---

Preserves the existing owner-approved STK50/51 approver narrowing as a scoped draft for handover. No new rule or grant changes are introduced during publication. Not merge-ready: current-main reconciliation, aggregate CI and stakeholder UAT remain pending.



Worktree: `/workspace/KPOne-stk50-51`; source recovery: `feature/stk-50-51-approver-narrowing` at `4e1bed537d82249ca5153705b5e5f997aa9a4371`.
Patch: `stk50-51.patch`.

The approved migration `2026_11_07_003800_narrow_purchase_order_and_supplier_invoice_approvers.php` revokes exactly two web-role grants: Finance Officer purchase-order approval and Director supplier-invoice mismatch approval. Down restores these two grants. Catalogue, service wording, UI wording, synthetic walk/trial actors and the historically approved assertions align with this boundary. No staff-management grants change. Beyond recovered source, the handoff-approved InventoryWalkSeederTest Director expectation is included, alongside a stale comment correction and reconciled TEAM documentation preserving IMP-1.

Validation: 10/10 focused frontend tests passed. Six focused backend classes passed 43/43 tests, 970 assertions, exit 0 in 66.956 seconds using explicit `--testsuite=Feature`. Full Pint and PHPStan passed with exit 0 (PHPStan errors: 0). JUnit and logs are included. Full branch/integration gate and visual/UAT review remain pending.

Runner diagnosis retained for reproducibility: default discovery had exited 1 despite passing tests because the unchanged phpunit.xml repeats 64 files from Contention in Contention1/2/3. Laravel PAO's JSON summary omitted the warning-driven exit status. `--debug` exposed those warnings; a single migration rerun selecting Feature passed with exit 0, followed by the full 43-test focused rerun. No configuration, migration or assertion change suppressed warnings. Earlier Pint timeout evidence is retained but superseded by a successful direct serial Pint run.

The two patches share TEAM.md and InventoryOperationsPanel.vue; integrate deliberately from a clean main checkout and reconcile the two progress entries. They are individual exact review artifacts, not a claim that sequential blind application is conflict-free.

Logs are copied into `evidence/`. The JSON manifests record the base, included untracked files and SHA-256 for each exact patch.




Publication update26 November2026: owner authorized commit/push/draft PR preservation. Historical no-publication wording above is superseded for this draft. Migration down restores exactly the two revoked grants, as recorded in the historical approval; no production migration was run. This overlaps STK46 PermissionCatalogue/TEAM and the Stock UI, so integrate deliberately; do not blindly apply all patches.
